_comment: SPDX-License-Identifier: MIT. Declared options of the Baseline 1 mission (openamrobot_build1_scene/baseline1.py). Proposed for Alex and Mohamed, 20 Nov 2026; a change is a reviewed change of this file. Simulation evidence only.

cancel_check._comment: baseline1_cancel.py. On only when BASELINE1_CANCEL_CHECK=1 (the acceptance workflow sets it). At the start of nav_to_station: one short NavigateToPose goal straight ahead of the spawn pose on open floor (not needed by the mission), cancelled through the public action once the base has moved cancel_at_m, then the base must stay still. The mission then continues with the station goal from where the base stopped. Values Proposed; the stop bounds reuse scn07_cancel_resume where one exists.
